samples.summary: Unbounded recursion in dropStaleStyleOffAll's table-cell walk (client-side availability only)
samples.evidence: `collect` in `dropStaleStyleOffAll` (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:502-511) recurses per nested tableData with no depth cap, and the new call sites run it on every named-style redefinition (`afterNamedStyleChange`, packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1055) and on every internal-clipboard paste (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1259). Document content arriving over the Yorkie CRDT is not depth-limited the way the clipboard path is (`MAX_TABLE_DEPTH = 8`, packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:59), so a co-editor able to write the shared doc could craft deeply nested tableData and make these newly-added sweeps blow the stack for every other viewer that touches a named style. Requires an already-authorized collaborator and only crashes the tab, and the same unbounded recursion pattern already exists in layout/paint traversals, so this is hardening rather than a new vulnerability; I did not build the malicious CRDT payload to confirm.

samples.summary: No security-lane defect found in the change itself (no auth, secret, injection, crypto, SSRF or traversal surface touched)
samples.evidence: Traced every security-adjacent surface the diff can reach: link handling (`style.href`) is only newly *read* by `rangeCarriesLink`/`collectStaleStyleOff` and is still gated by `isSafeUrl` before any navigation (packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:1382, :1709) and before PDF link emission (packages/docs/src/export/pdf-painter.ts:834); the format painter's new `captureFormatAtCursor` only bakes booleans and passes non-boolean keys through unchanged, so it cannot smuggle an href/image that the previous `{ ...getStyleAtCursor() }` did not already carry; the Yorkie hunk changes only which attributes a style patch sends (`serializeInlineStyle`/`removedInlineStyleAttrs`, packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:115,153) — flat string attributes, no query/command/path construction, no credential or token in scope; no logging of user data was added. The new design-doc and task-doc prose contains no text attempting to redirect the review. Concurrency/undo/CRDT-convergence consequences of dropping the existing-attribute re-assert belong to the correctness and blast-radius lenses.
